outcome: Expansion of undifferentiated granule cell precursors
Proliferation in the external granule cell layer (EGL)
Apoptotic cells in the internal granule cell layer (IGL)
Number of differentiating granule cells in the inner EGL
cohort: The study participants were preterm pigs delivered via caesarean section.
finding: Consumption of PS-DHA was associated with the expansion of undifferentiated granule cell precursors, increased proliferation in the external granule cell layer (EGL), and significantly fewer apoptotic cells in the internal granule cell layer (IGL), suggesting it supports cerebellar development in preterm subjects by enhancing granule cell proliferation and survival.
